items.title: Binding of Isaac developer removes AI music from Repentance Plus
items.excerpt: Nicalis pulled AI-generated music from a GTA 6-themed mode in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ after players exposed it and review-bombed the update; creator Edmund McMillen says he 'had no idea' AI music had been used.

items.title: 'Woke Up to a S**t Show' — The Binding of Isaac Creator Says He Was Unaware of Now-Removed AI-Generated Music in Repentance+
items.excerpt: The Binding of Isaac developer Nicalis has removed undisclosed AI-generated music included in Repentance+ after backlash led to a review-bombing campaign on Steam and a response from the game's creator, Edmund McMillen.

items.title: The Binding of Isaac's new update was review-bombed over AI-generated music, and now it's been removed
items.excerpt: Nicalis has removed AI-generated music from The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ after players found it in a GTA 6-themed run.

items.title: Activision Patent Would Let AI NPCs Learn From Toxic COD Lobbies
items.excerpt: A newly surfaced Activision patent describes training AI-driven NPCs on players' Call of Duty voice chat so enemies can learn to trash-talk like real players.

items.title: Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview 2 Brings Browser-Based Gaming To Blueprint-Only Projects, Enables AI Workflows By Default And Improves Rendering
items.excerpt: Epic's Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview 2 build brings Blueprint-only web games, turns AI toolsets on by default, adds WebGPU improvements and faster cinematic workflows.

items.title: Clash Royale Catches AI Cheat Creator, Recruits Him to Help Develop New Anti-Cheat System
items.excerpt: Supercell took an unusual approach to AI-powered cheating in Clash Royale: instead of simply banning the creator of an AI cheat tool, it recruited him to help build a new anti-cheat system.

items.title: Wizards of the Coast to pass full AI copyright payout to D&D writers
items.excerpt: Wizards of the Coast says it will pass its full share of the Anthropic AI copyright settlement for D&D books on to the writers who created them.

items.title: 스팀 'AI 사용 공개' 게임, 전반적으로 판매량 적었다
items.excerpt: 스팀에서 AI 사용 사실을 공개한 게임들이 그렇지 않은 작품보다 판매량이 적은 경향을 보였다는 분석. 다만 AI 사용 공개가 직접 판매 감소를 유발했다는 인과는 증명되지 않았고, 짧은 사전 홍보와 부족한 이용자 기반이 영향을 미쳤을 가능성이 제기됐다.

items.title: Steamでは「AI使用開示作品」の売上が低い傾向あり。でもほんとに開示のせいなのか、“はなから負けパターン”が透ける分析
items.excerpt: Steamのレビュー数から推定した売上が、AI使用の開示によってどう影響を受けるのかを統計的に分析したレポートが公開された。開示作品は売上が低い傾向だが、開示そのものが原因とは言い切れない。

items.title: 生成AIを活用したFMVゲーム「元カレ×デスゲーム」，2026年12月4日に基本プレイ無料で配信予定
items.excerpt: LIUGUANG STUDIO announced that its generative-AI-built live-action-style FMV game 'Ex-Boyfriend x Death Game', pitting the player against 100 exes on a cruise ship, launches free-to-play on December 4, 2026 (PC via Steam).

items.title: Student Game Development Competition Shut Down Because Kids Kept Submitting AI Slop
items.excerpt: A student video game development competition was cancelled after organizers were flooded with AI-generated submissions.

items.title: MetaHuman Animator Markerless Motion Capture Deep Dive | Inside Unreal
items.excerpt: Epic's Inside Unreal deep dive on the new MetaHuman Animator Markerless Motion Capture plugin, which turns ordinary video from a phone or camera into full-body animation without mocap suits or markers.
